University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Final September 2026 (Sep 25): 47.8 — near-record low (second only to May’s record). Missed 51.0 consensus by 3.2 points. Down 7.5% from August (51.7).  
Current Economic Conditions: 50.9 (−1.9%).  
Consumer Expectations: 45.8 (−15.7%).  
Year-ahead inflation expectations: 4.6% — highest since June, up from 4.0% in August. [...] For the Fed: 4.6% year-ahead expectations is a credibility signal. Combined with PMI input costs at 4-year highs, Barr "further adjustments needed," and October 73% priced, the October 27-28 case is building. August PCE: September 30.
